entries.name: 扶稳分腿蹲控制观察
entries.target: 一手扶固定支撑，前后脚分开站稳，两脚掌落地，双脚不交叉。
entries.edit_target: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/assess/018_E-LOW-023_扶稳分腿蹲控制观察.png
entries.full_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single rehabilitation demonstration photograph, starting frame of a 2-frame supported split squat, card E-LOW-023. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: existing split-squat photograph. Input images 2-4 are identity/style references only. Make one single portrait photograph, 1122 by 1402, no text, no collage.
Change ONLY the woman's pose from a lowered split stance to its UPRIGHT START POSITION. Preserve her exact identity, age, face, black ponytail, white short-sleeved shirt, dark charcoal trousers and plain white trainers. Keep the existing full-body oblique side camera, focal length, subject scale, blue-gray seamless background, soft studio light, floor marks, fixed metal handrail geometry and positions absolutely unchanged.
Her forward planted shoe must stay at exactly its current floor position above the front floor marker; its entire sole and heel contact the floor. The rear toes stay at exactly the existing rear position above the rear marker, but LOWER THE REAR HEEL gently to the floor so the entire rear sole contacts the floor in the start frame. The feet remain front-and-back with no crossing, not drawn together. Raise the pelvis and torso into tall stable split-stance standing, both hips and knees comfortably nearly extended, no lunge descent, no step. One far-side hand continues to hold the rail at precisely the same rail contact position; the arm can adjust its elbow naturally. Near-side hand rests at the side. Upright neutral torso and relaxed shoulders. Both complete feet, hands, head, and all support contact points remain visible. Normal adult head-to-body ratio, continuous joints, anatomically plausible limb lengths and hands. Do not alter props, shoe styles, floor, background or facial identity. No arrows, no labels, no extra people.

revisions.reason: 初始起始图后脚前掌比原终点前移；局部修正后脚。
revisions.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise localized edit. Input image 1 is the starting split-stance photograph to correct; input image 2 is its endpoint continuity reference. Produce one portrait photo, same 1122x1402.
Make one small correction ONLY: reposition the REAR FOOT and its connecting lower leg slightly farther back so its front toe contact corresponds exactly to the rear toe ground contact in image 2. In image 2 the rear sneaker toe tip is approximately x373 y1204; in image 1 it wrongly moved to x437. The corrected rear sneaker toe must land at approximately x373 y1204 with its sole horizontal and entire heel flat on the floor. This should restore a slightly longer front-to-back split stance. Adjust only the rear ankle, rear knee and rear lower-leg chain as anatomically needed, keeping both legs nearly straight in the UPRIGHT START POSITION. Do not bend down into image 2's squat. Both soles on floor in this start image.
Preserve ALL other details of input image 1, including exact face, proportions, head height, upright torso/pelvis, foreground support shoe location, handrail, exact holding hand location, free hand, camera, background, lighting, white t-shirt and dark gray pants and white sneakers. The forward shoe does NOT move. Keep fixed rail and floor markers at precisely their current coordinates. No text or arrows. The only intended change is restoring rear foot toe floor position for same-foot-position sequence.
revisions.qa: 修正图符合直立准备位；后脚位置仍与原单图有差异，因此不复用原单图终点，以修正起始图重生成s02。
revisions.failure_before_retry: 首次局部修正调用遇网络错误，原参数重试内置imagegen成功。

entries.name: 扶稳分腿蹲控制观察
entries.target: 固定前后脚位和扶持，屈髋屈膝下降，前脚跟留地。
entries.full_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: endpoint frame of a supported split squat, E-LOW-023. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and establishes the fixed camera, identity, foot positions and all prop geometry. Input image 2 is only an example of the kind of shallow split-squat descent; do not copy its different rear foot location.
Produce one full-body portrait photograph 1122x1402. Change ONLY the woman's hip and knee posture to LOWER INTO A SHALLOW FIXED-STANCE SPLIT SQUAT. Lower her pelvis about 8-10 cm directly downward with a stable upright torso. Both knees visibly bend in the same front-to-back split stance: front knee about 40 degrees flexion, rear knee gently bent toward the floor, no kneeling. The forward planted white sneaker remains exactly where it appears in image 1, entire sole and heel on floor. CRITICAL: the rear forefoot and toes must stay at exactly image 1's rear contact point, rear toe tip around x425 y1195; do not move this rear toe left or right, and do not bring feet together. Only rear heel may lift naturally while its same forefoot stays on the ground. No stepping or foot sliding. The rear knee bends a little instead of the rear foot repositioning. Her holding hand stays at image 1's exact handrail contact point, arm adjusts elbow naturally; free near-side hand relaxed beside her thigh.
Preserve image 1's same woman and realistic proportions, face, hairstyle, white t-shirt, charcoal pants, white trainers, exact rail geometry and screen positions, foreground planted foot, camera and crop, floor markers, blue gray background and studio lighting. Her head moves lower only as dictated by whole-body descent, same head size. Full head, both feet and both hands visible. No text, arrows, ghost limbs or extra people. Normal adult anatomy.

entries.name: 椅前目标单腿浅蹲观察
entries.target: 目标椅前一手扶稳，支撑脚留地，另一脚离地，单腿站立起始。
entries.edit_target: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/assess/019_E-LOW-024_椅前目标单腿浅蹲观察.png
entries.full_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single rehabilitation demonstration photograph, starting frame of supported single-leg shallow squat in front of a target chair, E-LOW-024. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: existing shallow single-leg squat endpoint. Images 2-4 lock the same woman's identity and photographic style. One portrait photograph, 1122 by 1402, no collage, arrows, text or labels.
Change ONLY the woman's posture to an UPRIGHT SINGLE-LEG START POSITION. Preserve exact blue-gray seamless background and floor, lighting, camera angle, focal length, body scale, face and age, black ponytail, white short sleeve top, dark charcoal trousers and white trainers. Keep gray chair behind her and the fixed metal rail at precisely the same screen positions, sizes and shapes.
The support shoe (the planted lower shoe) stays exactly in its current floor position with sole flat on floor. Extend its hip and knee into tall standing with a gentle natural soft knee, pelvis and torso rising upright directly over that foot. Her other knee may remain lightly flexed in front, but lower the lifted knee from the current high bent position; that NON-SUPPORT SHOE must stay visibly off the floor by a small clear gap of about 5 cm. Weight is carried by one leg only. Keep one hand on the exact same rail contact point, with natural elbow flexion as torso rises. Free near-side hand relaxed by her hip. The chair remains behind the pelvis and is unused; do not sit, touch, lean on or move the chair. Preserve the planted foot, props and ground line identically for continuity with the endpoint frame. Anatomically realistic lengths, feet and hands. Head, both shoes, both hands, chair seat and pelvis entirely visible.

entries.name: 单腿髋铰链够取与回正观察
entries.target: 一手扶固定支撑，支撑膝自然微屈，另一脚轻离地，够取目标可触及。
entries.edit_target: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/assess/020_E-LOW-025_单腿髋铰链够取与回正观察.png
entries.full_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single rehabilitation demonstration photograph, starting frame of a supported single-leg hip-hinge reaching task, E-LOW-025. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: existing hip-hinge endpoint photograph. Images 2-4 are only identity/style references. Produce one portrait photograph 1122 by 1402. No collage, text, arrows or labels.
Change ONLY the woman's pose to the UPRIGHT SINGLE-LEG START POSITION before hinging. Preserve the identical middle-aged East Asian woman, facial identity and age, black ponytail, white short sleeved shirt, charcoal trousers and white sneakers, soft studio photography and blue-gray seamless floor/background. Keep camera, focal length, body scale, ground line and ALL props fixed: the handrail remains exactly where it is, the reachable gray target table remains exactly where it is with exactly its same height and shape.
Her supporting shoe stays precisely at its existing screen and floor coordinates, the whole sole planted and knee naturally slightly bent. Raise pelvis and neutral straight torso upright, balanced over this support foot. Bring the rear extended leg back toward her body: knee relaxed, the non-support foot hovering 4 to 5 cm clear of the floor behind/adjacent to the support leg. It remains non-weight-bearing. Her far-side support hand MUST continue resting/gripping exactly the existing contact point on the handrail; elbow flexes naturally. Her near-side free reaching hand is now relaxed at her side, well away from the table. The SAME gray table target remains visibly in front at reachable height. The movement is a return from the displayed hip hinge, not stepping to a new place. Keep head, both hands, both feet, rail and target table in the frame and anatomically realistic. Natural continuous shoulders, hips, knees and wrists. Do not move or change the support foot or rail/table.

revisions.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the edit target. Input image 2 is the endpoint frame for matching the handrail grip. One portrait photo same dimensions and all scene details.
ONLY correct the FAR-SIDE SUPPORT ARM AND HAND so it contacts exactly the same handrail point as in image 2: MOVE THE HOLDING HAND ALONG THE EXISTING RAIL 6 CM TO THE RIGHT in the photo, so its fingertips are near x876 at y598 and palm near x823 at y609. In image 1 the hand incorrectly rests directly above the vertical post; it must instead rest on the horizontal rail TO THE RIGHT OF THE POST, separated from the post by about one palm width, matching image 2. Reach the support arm naturally a little farther forward while keeping the shoulder location and upright torso fixed. Fingers and palm must visibly contact the rail with an anatomically normal wrist. There are exactly two hands, this is only relocation of the existing support hand.
Preserve the entire remainder of input image 1 unchanged: exact same woman, face, body proportions, upright single-leg pose, planted foot at same floor coordinates, raised non-support foot, near-side relaxed free arm/hand, camera, light, blue gray background, clothing, sneakers, handrail geometry and target table location/height. No text, diagrams, arrows or other objects. Do not move the handrail. Do not alter the support foot.
